role: Barrel module exporting the knowledge graph domain types, persistence protocols, and graph operations for Co-Being Layer 3.
detail: Core knowledge graph center-of-gravity module for the Co-Being architecture. Exports domain types: KnowledgeNode, KnowledgeEdge, NodeStatus, SchemaLevel. Exports persistence protocols: GraphPersistence, BehavioralStore, InMemoryGraphPersistence. Exports observation ingestion: add_observation, create_observation_session, close_observation_session with IngestionResult/ObservationSession. Exports temporal/spatial queries: get_scene_at, get_provenance_chain, add_spatial_relationship (SpatialResult). Exports read interface for Layer 4: get_current_scene, get_changes_since, get_spatial_relationships, get_object_history, get_type_instances, get_schema_types, get_pending_proposals, get_untyped_instances. Exports confidence decay (run_confidence_decay, DecayResult), bootstrap (bootstrap_graph, COBEING_SELF_NODE_ID, BootstrapResult), and health metrics. Exports guardian operations: add_guardian_statement, create_schema_proposal, apply_schema_proposal, reject_schema_proposal. Exports integrity validation: validate_graph_integrity, check_attractor_warnings. Exports expectations/similarity: ExpectationManager, SimilarityComputer, PredictionCheckResult, PropertyExpectation, SimilarityCluster. Exports behavioral events: ProposalOutcome, GapLifecycleEvent, VerificationResult, SessionSummary, BehavioralBaseline. Exports consolidation engine: ConsolidationEngine, ConsolidationAnalysis, ConsolidationReport. Exports compute_encoding_strength utility.
gotchas: None visible in barrel; all implementation in submodules. Extensive Epic 4/5 types (expectations, similarity, behavioral verification) indicate ongoing feature work in progress.
